arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, domain_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%calcium channel blocker%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%amlodipine%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%verapamil%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%diltiazem%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nifedipine%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%felodipine%'
   OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%nisoldipine%'
   AND standard_concept = 'S'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, concept_name
LIMIT 60;

SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id, c.domain_id, c.standard_concept
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%bradycardia%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cardiac conduction%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%heart block% first degree%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%sinus bradycardia%'
   OR c.concept_class_id = 'Clinical Filter'
ORDER BY c.standard_concept DESC, c.concept_name
LIMIT 60;
